description: This file defines the public API for DAC (Digital-to-Analog Converter) drivers in the Zephyr project, including structures, function prototypes, and macros for configuring and writing to DAC channels.

methods.name: dac_channel_setup
methods.description: Configures a DAC channel with specified settings before use.

methods.name: dac_write_value
methods.description: Writes a value to a specified DAC channel.
